polityNote: Kingdom of Thailand from the re-establishment of Kalasin (1 Oct 1947), after the return of the territories annexed in 1941–1946. Atoms: the 928 amphoe and khet of geoBoundaries THA ADM2 (Royal Thai Survey Department / OCHA ROAP, 2019), assigned to provinces from Wikipedia's district list. A province is the union of its amphoe; whole-amphoe province creations (Yasothon 1972, Phayao 1977, Mukdahan 1982, Amnat Charoen, Nong Bua Lam Phu and Sa Kaeo 1993, Bueng Kan 2011) are unions. Where a subdistrict or village moved between provinces (th.wikipedia amphoe histories, all 878 + 50 read), the provinces on both sides are drawn only from the last such transfer. Replaces the earlier Natural Earth dossier (1974–2019), whose lines put Ban Pong in Kanchanaburi, Lam Thap in Nakhon Si Thammarat, Krathum Baen in Nakhon Pathom and nine other amphoe in the wrong province. ① Areas of the 77 provinces of 2019 (union of atoms / Statoids table): median 1.002, range 0.922 (Loei) to 1.167 (Satun, whose atoms include sea and the Songkhla lake shore, as do Phatthalung 1.132); Chiang Mai 1.106, Kanchanaburi and Ratchaburi within 2%.
